test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If (2, 7), (5, 1), (x, 3) are the vertices of a triangle whose area is 18 (sq. units), then find the possible value of x.
solution:
**Given:**

Vertices of triangle = (2, 7), (5, 1), (x, 3)

**Formula:**

Area of triangle = 1/2 × [x1(y2 - y3) + x2(y3 - y1) + x3(y1 - y2)]

**Calculation:**

⇒ 18 = 1/2 × [2(1 - 3) + 5(3 - 7) + x(7 - 1)]

⇒ 36 = -4 - 20 + 6x

⇒ 6x = 60

⇒ x = 10

**∴ Value of x = 10.**

 

 

**NOTE: Options are changed as given options are not correct.**
